On this walk you study the making of twentieth-century commercial Delhi.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Outer Circle orientation
  • Radial streets and colonnades
  • Central Park viewpoint
  • Heritage reuse stop

How the time is spent

  1. Outer Circle orientation 20 min

    Introduce Lutyens-era/early 20th-century CP planning.

    You: plan geometry

  2. Radial streets and colonnades 35 min

    Study commercial frontage and pedestrian circulation.

    You: urban sketch

  3. Central Park viewpoint 30 min

    Read urban axis and civic symbolism.

    You: map uses

  4. Heritage reuse stop 20 min

    Discuss building adaptation and conservation.

    You: facades checklist

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Connaught Place Architecture using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study the making of twentieth-century commercial Delhi.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Connaught Place, Delhi
For

What to bring
